name: Cinder Kiln
text:
Whenever a source you control deals exactly 1 noncombat damage to any target, put an ember counter on Cinder Kiln.
Remove three ember counters from Cinder Kiln: You may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. Activate only as a sorcery.
